dj.line: That fee field isn't a number, it's a hand on the dial — the house can reach in and turn the rake while your chips are still on the felt. You sat down anyway; so what's the tell you're betting against, the hook or yourself?

items.text: New Uniswap V4 hook pool initialized at block 26383133. Hook: 0x6c24…e8cc. Tokens: 0xc02a…6cc2 / 0xdace…4f05. Fee: 8388608.

dj.line:
A rake that shifts while the cards are still face down — somebody at this table reserved the right to reach into the pot and take more, and they didn't ask permission. The ticker says fee, but what it means is leverage over every hand you're holding.

You still think the odds on the felt are the odds you agreed to?
